gap_c_source_traceability.investigation_method: Traced real persisted evidence records for all three named runs: raw_agent_outputs.json (agent free-text reports), structured_agent_outputs.json (claim/evidence records), the backend structured-output schema (comqutor_alpha/api/artifact_export.py, agent_output_reader.py), API response types (frontend/src/api/types.ts), and the Evidence-rendering components (ResearchRunPage.tsx, AlphaCard.tsx, ConflictEvidenceSections.tsx).

findings.literal_urls_in_raw_data: zero, across all three tickers (grepped every raw_agent_outputs.json for https?://)
findings.structured_source_fields_in_backend_or_f: none -- every field named 'source' anywhere in the pipeline (source_type, source_section, source_agent_output_id, source_refs; frontend AlphaMemoryPhiStructure.source, StructureGraphEdge.source) is an internal category/section-heading/internal-id, never a publisher/URL/date
findings.informal_publisher_mentions_in_free_text: The News/Sentiment Analyst's raw markdown report occasionally opens a bullet with a real publisher name and headline as plain prose (e.g. "Barron's: \"Why Stocks Are Loving the Fed's Rate Hike...\""), and this text is preserved verbatim in the claim/evidence fields once split into structured claims.
findings.informal_mention_prevalence: NVDA: 5/240 news+sentiment claims (2.1%); QQQ: 3/199 (1.5%); SNDK: 0/161 (0.0%) -- rare, inconsistent, and entirely absent for one of the three named tickers
findings.conclusion: CASE 2 applies: no genuine, structured, reliably-present external source metadata (publisher field, URL, source date, document locator) exists anywhere in the current persisted pipeline for any of the three tickers. The rare informal publisher-name mentions are prose, not metadata, and the task explicitly forbids inferring/extracting a publisher from free text -- doing so would mean writing a regex over ~1-2%-prevalence, ticker-inconsistent text and presenting the result as if it were a verified field, which is exactly the fabrication this task prohibits.

gap_c_source_traceability.action_taken: No propagation code written (there is nothing genuine to propagate). Added a small, static, honest disclosure -- not derived from parsing any text -- to the two primary evidence-rendering surfaces: ResearchRunPage.tsx's 'Analyst findings' panel and ConflictEvidenceSections.tsx's evidence sections. Wording: 'This evidence text is each agent's own research output. COMQUTOR does not currently track a verified external publisher, URL, or publish date for individual claims -- a claim_id ... is an internal reference only, not external source verification.' No claim_id/internal id is ever labeled or styled as a source.
